name: load-template-library
body: Load template library: resolve the library root from the deck config — the `templates:` path when set (a relative path resolved against the deck root, or an absolute path), otherwise the local `templates/`; neither resolvable = error (templates-dir-required) — then validate the resolved root fail-fast (templates-dir-validation) and build the template and theme registries from its files; the first failure is a templates error. A configured path is authoritative: it never silently falls back to a local `templates/`.
